scripts.build:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary:darwin && pnpm run esbuild
scripts.build-dev:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-dev:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-dev && pnpm run build-types
scripts.build-prod:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-prod:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-prod
scripts.buildBinary-prod:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/Textractor' ]; then rm -rf bin/Textractor; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/Textractor/Textractor.xcodeproj -scheme Textractor -configuration Release -derivedDataPath src/swift/Textractor/build && cp src/swift/Textractor/build/Build/Products/Release/Textractor bin/Textractor && shasum -a 256 bin/Textractor > dist/Textractor.sha256
scripts.buildBinary-dev:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/dev/Textractor' ]; then rm -rf bin/dev/Textractor; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/Textractor/Textractor.xcodeproj -scheme Textractor -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath src/swift/Textractor/build && cp src/swift/Textractor/build/Build/Products/Debug/Textractor bin/dev/Textractor && shasum -a 256 bin/dev/Textractor > dist/Textractor.sha256
